summary: Backend testing for Iteration 8 Customer Support system (tickets + FAQ + admin dashboard). Created /app/backend/tests/test_iter8_support_tickets.py with 25 pytest cases covering all support endpoints + key regression checks. All 25 tests PASSED. Gmail SMTP fails (BadCredentials, as documented) but APIs correctly return 200 — email send is fire-and-forget via asyncio.create_task().
action_items: (NON-CODE) Gmail App-Password (SUPPORT_GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD) is rejected by Google with 5.7.8 BadCredentials. Backend gracefully logs and continues — no code fix needed. User must regenerate App Password from Google account (with 2FA on) to enable real email delivery.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~2588 lines — past the recommended 700-line ceiling. Consider splitting support endpoints into /app/backend/routers/support.py for maintainability.

Rate-limit (5/email/hour) is purely DB-count-based and uses string ISO comparison on created_at — works because timestamps are ISO-8601 lexically sortable, but susceptible to clock skew. Consider storing created_at as native datetime and querying with datetime objects.

send_email + _gmail_smtp_send do synchronous SMTP inside an async context (via smtplib). Even though wrapped in asyncio.create_task, the blocking smtplib call can stall the event loop. Consider aiosmtplib or running smtplib in run_in_executor.

EmailStr is validated but the in-route 400 for invalid category fires only after Pydantic accepts the body — fine, but could move to Pydantic Literal[...] for category to get a 422 with field details instead of free-form 400.
GET /api/support/tickets/{id} returns 403 'Not your ticket' but does not differentiate from 404 — acceptable for security (no info disclosure).
test_credentials: Admin: test@tactician.gg / strongpw1 (in SUPPORT_ADMIN_EMAILS). Non-admin: fresh TEST_nonadmin_<uuid>@tactician.gg registered per test session.
seed_data_creation: Each test creates its own ticket(s) and cleans up via cleanup_tickets fixture (deletes by id from db.support_tickets). Rate-limit test pre-deletes any prior tickets for its unique email. Daily-login regression resets db.scout_earnings for the admin user.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter8 support endpoints all green. Test file /app/backend/tests/test_iter8_support_tickets.py is the canonical regression suite for support tickets. Reuse the admin_auth (login) and non_admin_auth (fresh register) fixtures pattern for future role-gated tests. SUPPORT_ADMIN_EMAILS is read from env at import time in server.py — if you change the env var, restart backend. Gmail SMTP will continue to log BadCredentials until the user re-issues an App Password; this is a credentials issue, not a code issue.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional issues found. Documented Gmail SMTP BadCredentials produces logged errors only; the API layer correctly isolates the response from the email side-effect via asyncio.create_task, verified in test_create_ticket_guest_returns_200 and the rate-limit test.
